Kim / team — quick technical confirmation:

- Hosted plan: we do routing by regional preference (EU/US) but it's probabilistic on shared pools; we cannot guarantee zero-US egress on hosted at present.
- Dedicated/Private: we support strict origin-based routing (region pinning) and we can enable UK-only routing for their tenant.
- For the three subprocessors: only XferCloud and ObserveAI can be configured for onshore (ObserveAI only for Dedicated customers); TraceMetrics is contractual routing only.

Recommendation: Flag to Globex that to get contractual and technical guarantees (no US egress for UK sessions + UK IDTA execution) they should opt for Dedicated. If they cannot move to Dedicated, we will supply a TIA that documents the safeguards, but it will note routing is best-effort on hosted.
